record.statement: ∑_{k=1}^{n}(2k-1) = 2·(∑_{k=1}^{n} k) − n = 2·n(n+1)/2 − n = n(n+1) − n = n², using the closed form for the sum of the first n positive integers.
Inductive-step identity: (n+1)² − n² = 2n + 1 = 2(n+1) − 1, i.e. the difference of consecutive squares is exactly the (n+1)-th odd summand; hence an induction on n closes immediately.
